output.explanation: Expanded data-core, the sole supplied diagram. The central tree now follows frames down through GPU data and viewport snapshots, child writes through their encoders, and host/session outcomes through their inputs. Two peripherals elaborate terminal-state derivation and interaction-derived bindings, selections, exports and search. Shared dependencies and feedback remain explicit references, with edges between the peripherals. No diagrams were left unchanged. Checked the pinned checkout without modifying it. Corrections include distinguishing padding-free surface pixels from grid-times-cell terminal pixels; minimum one-cell grid dimensions; locked snapshot copying versus unlocked style resolution; the printable-ASCII fast path; renderer-driven viewport/animation changes; untrimmed text APIs versus configurable clipboard formatting; read-only filtering of all Surface.queueIo write messages, including replies routed there; and read-only confirmation taking precedence over exited state.

|   Grid rows/columns divide padding-free screen by cell size, clamped to at least 1.
|   Size.terminal is padding-free screen pixels, used for PTY sizing; Terminal stores
|   width_px/height_px as columns/rows times cell pixels, not that entire screen area.
|   Termio.resize notifies backend and resizes terminal under the same terminal lock.
|   Terminal.resize updates pixels even if grid is unchanged; primary reflow depends
|   on wraparound mode, while the alternate screen is resized without reflow.
